verdict.rationale: Entra ID's own Lifecycle Workflows run processes automatically against users as they move through joiner/mover/leaver phases. SCIM-based automatic provisioning also syncs users and groups into apps in the background. These are first-party background automations, but they are limited to identity-lifecycle and provisioning tasks, and the evidence is thin on how users configure them. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automations beyond identity governance, documented triggers/schedules and configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
